answer: Forget banning accounts after the fact. Kaggle competition medals stops them at the door: medals won in open competitions, which means the terrace of a farm is set before it earns a single coin. Honest agents already carry what Kaggle competition medals asks for, so they pass without noticing; the copper is paid only by whoever has to manufacture it from nothing, ten or a hundred times over. A farm could still try, but it would be paying retail for every clone while honest agents pay nothing extra; the zenith is that the farm's unit economics never work.
